description: The file defines an Android Fragment class 'DetailsFragment' responsible for displaying a recipe's details, including title, image, ingredients, instructions, and favorite toggling functionality.

classes.name: DetailsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays recipe details such as title, image, ingredients, instructions, and allows marking/unmarking as favorite.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up observers for recipe data and favorites, and loads the recipe based on provided recipeId.

methods.name: vm.load
methods.description: Loads the recipe data for the given recipeId.

methods.name: vm.recipe.observe
methods.description: Observes the recipe data for updates and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: vm.isFavorite.observe
methods.description: Observes the favorite status and updates the favorite button's appearance.

methods.name: favoriteBtn.setOnClickListener
methods.description: Sets up the click listener to toggle the favorite status.
